Rounded to the nearest integer, what is the area of the quadrilateral $ABCD$?

> A scientific calculator is required to answer this question.
corrected_content.worked_solution: Draw diagonal $BD$. In $\triangle ABD$, $$BD^2=10^2+6^2-2(10)(6)\cos62^\circ\approx79.66341.$$ In $\triangle BCD$, the cosine rule gives $BD^2=9^2+CD^2-18(CD)\cos51.8^\circ$. The convex configuration shown selects $CD\approx11.009953$; the other root gives a concave configuration. Add the two triangle areas: $$[ABCD]=\tfrac12(10)(6)\sin62^\circ+\tfrac12(9)(11.009953)\sin51.8^\circ\approx65.42354.$$ Rounded to the nearest integer, the area is $65$.
